# Client Portal Structure

Give the client **one place to go**. A Notion page, Google Drive folder, or ClickUp/Trello board works. Put its link in
`onboarding.portal_link`, then tick **Client portal live**; the client gets the link automatically.

```
[Client] × [Your Business]
├── Project overview        goal, scope, people, links
├── Timeline                milestones and dates
├── Tasks                   what's in progress / waiting on client / done
├── Deliverables            each version, with date and status
├── Reports                 weekly/monthly results
├── Meeting notes           kickoff + every call, with decisions and next steps
├── Files & links           brand assets, access list, contract, invoices
└── Next steps              always up to date, top of the page
```

If the client needs five places to track one project, the system is broken.
